key.name: game-app-ids
key.description: WM_CLASS values (as reported by Meta.Window.get_wm_class) that identify a window as a game, in addition to any fullscreen window matched by treat-fullscreen-as-game.

key.name: treat-fullscreen-as-game
key.description: Automatically apply the game scale to any fullscreen window, regardless of whether its WM_CLASS is in the game list.

key.name: game-scale
key.summary: Scale factor to use while a game is focused
key.description: The display scale factor applied while a game window is focused. 1.0 is 100%.

key.name: only-scale-active-monitor
key.summary: Only rescale the monitor showing the game
key.description: When true, only the logical monitor the game window is on has its scale changed; every other monitor keeps its original scale. When false, all monitors are rescaled together.

key.name: ignored-app-ids
key.description: WM_CLASS values that are never treated as a game, even while fullscreen. Takes priority over treat-fullscreen-as-game and game-app-ids, so it's meant for things like browsers and video players where fullscreen doesn't mean "game".
